entities.summary: James Patrick Gorman is an Australian-American businessman and financier. He is Chairman Emeritus of Morgan Stanley. Prior to becoming Chairman Emeritus in January 2025, Gorman served as Executive Chairman from January to December 2024, CEO from January 2010 until December 2023 and Chairman from January 2012 until December 2023. He joined the firm in February 2006 and was named Co-President in December 2007. Since January 2, 2025, he has been the Chairman of the Walt Disney Company.
